selection: Chosen from development aggregate quality/cost; no test hypothesis or score has been opened.
decision_rules: Keep WER normalization unchanged including acronym tokenization.
Report overall and every language; any language regression fails promotion.
At least 5% relative aggregate WER improvement and meaningful Russian improvement are necessary, not sufficient.
Missing speaker independence, adjudicated names/numbers/negation, continuous-phone and resource evidence blocks promotion even if numeric scores improve.
Do not tune against these test results; later tuned policies require fresh held-out data.
uncertainty: Only five clips per language; speaker IDs absent. No population confidence interval or significance claim.
timing: Single cold host process per clip, sequential variants; descriptive only, not phone/warm or repeated-alternating evidence.
